reason: Fixes a semantic merge conflict from batch 3 (#1063): #1021 made serve's listener go through stable_listener_config, which always passes timeout_graceful_shutdown, and #1023 passed the same keyword at the serve call, so every `nebula-core serve` exited with a TypeError right after its ready line. Selection: the listener and serve-config tests (new cases build serve's config inherited and not, and reject an unbounded listener), the runtime service tests, and the two tests that start a real serve end to end.
exclusions: test_runtime_host_knowledge_bootstrap's serve test needs a non-loopback LAN address and test_shutdown_readmission's needs the cached embedding model; both are selected so CI runs them where available. Verified locally by starting a real `nebula-core serve` on 8fe806a (exits 1 with the TypeError) and on this branch (alive, /api/v1/health 200, stops on SIGTERM).
